title: Dementia: type, stage and behavior
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cognitive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for memory loss and cognitive changes.

HPI
The patient is a 65-year-old man presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his cognitive status. He is accompanied by his spouse, who notes that he has had increasing difficulty with short-term memory and word-finding over the last several months. The patient is calm and cooperative during the interview. He denies any mood disturbances or behavioral issues. He is able to follow simple commands but requires frequent prompting to complete complex tasks.

Medication List
Donepezil 10mg daily
Lisinopril 20mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person and place only. He is cooperative and shows no signs of behavioral disturbance. Speech is clear but occasionally hesitant. Cognition is impaired as evidenced by dementia. Reflexes are intact.

Assessment
Dementia.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. We will monitor his cognitive status and provide support for his spouse. Follow up in three months for a reassessment of his symptoms.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, PA-C, 05/14/2026
explanations: Dementia of unspecified type (F03.-), unspecified severity, without behavioral disturbance: F03.90.

distractors.why: The stage is not documented: use the unspecified-severity code.
